beats.td-3-001: You approach the soaring stilt-legs of Saltspire, discovering the rusted winch-lifts are heavily guarded by Brineholder mercenaries who demand a steep toll for entry.
beats.td-3-026: Ascending into the lower districts, you realise Saltspire is parched, and the Brineholders strictly ration all freshwater to control the populace.
beats.td-3-050: You learn Orsolya Venn was seen being escorted by the Brineholder elite towards the upper canopy, leaving a trail of coded chalk marks.
beats.td-3-071: A patrol of heavily armed Brineholder enforcers blocks the main thoroughfare, conducting brutal searches for suspected Drift Pilgrim sympathisers.
beats.td-3-086: Emerging near the upper canopy, you behold the magnificent, glass-domed water reservoirs of the Brineholders, glittering under the harsh sun.
beats.td-3-107: Inside the archives, you discover documents proving the Brineholders know the Meridian Gear is jammed and intend to destroy it.
beats.td-3-127: An alarm bell shatters the quiet, signalling that your intrusion has been noticed, forcing a frantic escape toward the governor's spire.
beats.td-3-141: You crash through a skylight into the opulent chambers of the Brineholder Governor, finding him locked in a tense negotiation.
beats.td-3-165: Orsolya is not here, but the Governor reveals she was taken down the Sunken Stair by the Hollow Choir as a hostage.
beats.td-3-192: The winch deposits you at the very base of Saltspire, where the shadows are long and the entrance to the Stair looms.
beats.td-3-211: Standing before the spiralling abyss of the Sunken Stair, you take a deep breath and begin the dark descent towards the Gear.

td-3-002.situation: A sprawling shanty of shipwreck timber clings to the lower stilts, teeming with desperate scavengers looking for a way up.

td-3-027.situation: A chaotic bazaar suspended on netting, where desperate citizens trade salvage for tiny measures of precious, muddy water.

td-3-051.situation: A network of precarious rope bridges connects the middle tiers, battered by sudden, fierce salt winds.

td-3-072.situation: Dark, narrow steam vents offer a perilous alternative route upward, echoing with the moans of trapped gulls.

td-3-087.situation: A grand, patrolled promenade wrapping around the immense glass water tanks, offering incredible views and terrible danger.

td-3-108.situation: A neglected library of damp, rotting charts and tidal records, guarded by intricate mechanical locks.

td-3-128.situation: A slanted, terrifying expanse of slate roofs and guttering connecting the archives to the central palace.

td-3-142.situation: A sun-drenched room filled with dying exotic plants and nervous aristocrats making desperate bargains.

td-3-166.situation: A massive, groaning mechanical elevator meant to lower brave souls directly towards the exposed seabed.

td-3-193.situation: A gloomy labyrinth of petrified wood and coral forming the foundation of the city in the dry dark.

chains.td-3-002/4: You stare down a territorial thug guarding a secret ladder, risking a beating to win his begrudging respect and free passage.
